Hi Sarah — thanks for sending these over and for filling out most of the registration form. A few small follow-ups from the Redwood side so we can create the vendor master record and configure PO/invoice routing: 

1) Legal entity confirmation: please confirm the exact legal entity name to appear on contracts and POs (incl. punctuation). You listed "Calypso Instruments, Inc." which should be fine but we need the signed attestation.
2) Billing address vs remit address: confirm if invoices should be sent to invoices@calypso-instruments.com or to the HQ mailing address.
3) Bank details: in the Bank Authorization doc please add a copy of a voided check or bank letter to speed ACH setup.
4) Tax documents: W-9 received — thanks. If you are foreign (not the case here) we'd need a W-8.
5) PO reference: Do you require a specific PO acknowledgement cadence or custom PO number formatting (prefix/suffix)? If so, provide an example.

Next steps from our side once we have the above:
- Marcus (AP) will create the vendor master record with the legal name and remit account.
- Rishi (Finance ops) will set payment terms (defaulting to Net30 unless you request otherwise) and confirm ACH routing verification steps.

If it's easier, we can also take a quick 20-minute call this afternoon to walk through the packet and confirm fields. Let me know your availability.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
